name: Input Directory
tip: Path to the directory containing the 1024D embedded .npy files.

name: Output Directory
tip: Where the final 2D visualization plot will be saved.

name: Generate Plot
tip: If checked, it will generate an interactive .html plot.

name: Clustering Algorithm
tip: Choose between K-Means (fixed clusters) or DBSCAN (density-based).

name: K-Means Clusters
tip: Only used for K-Means. Total number of clusters to find.

name: DBSCAN Epsilon
tip: DBSCAN distance threshold. Higher values merge more points into one cluster.

name: DBSCAN Min Samples
tip: Minimum points needed to form a 'dense' cluster region.

name: Dimensionality Reducer
tip: Method to project 1024D data down to a 2D plot.

name: t-SNE Perplexity
tip: Only used for t-SNE. Influences the balance between local and global aspects of your data.
